rules.statement: an app entry module is its thin wiring adapter and may compose anything (§II)
rules.remedy: list a file here only if it IS a composition root, never to silence a finding

rules.statement: plugin-sdk and agent-bridge wrap core for plugin authors and UI surfaces, and reach nothing concrete
rules.remedy: take the implementation through a contract; let wiring compose it

rules.statement: every error-severity rule has a fixture it catches
rules.remedy: add a file that deliberately breaks this rule

rules.statement: an extension implements contracts and never reaches wiring or apps
rules.remedy: depend on the contract in @ethosagent/types; let wiring compose

rules.statement: the security kernel depends only on contracts and vendored shims
rules.remedy: take the dependency through a contract in @ethosagent/types

rules.statement: @ethosagent/types has zero imports and zero deps (§II L1)
rules.remedy: move the shared type into @ethosagent/types, or stop sharing it

rules.statement: library code does not write to the console (Law 10)
rules.remedy: use the injected Logger; only apps/ethos/src may print

rules.statement: core never imports concrete implementations (§II L2)
rules.remedy: receive the implementation through AgentLoopConfig injection

rules.statement: wiring is the composition root and may import every layer
rules.remedy: declare a layer for the new folder in architecture.config.ts

rules.statement: apps depend on contracts and wiring only; concrete implementations come via wiring (Law 5)
rules.remedy: reach the implementation through @ethosagent/wiring

rules.statement: dynamic imports name a literal specifier so the graph stays readable
rules.remedy: import a literal specifier, or register the module in a table

rules.statement: a catch block handles, rethrows or explains the error it swallows
rules.remedy: log, rethrow, or comment why the failure is safe to ignore

rules.statement: exceptions live in the manifest with an owner and an expiry, not inline
rules.remedy: fix the code, or record an exception in architecture.config.ts

rules.statement: observability-sqlite depends only on types, safety-redact and the sqlite shim, so it stays extractable
rules.remedy: take the dependency as an injected contract from @ethosagent/types

rules.statement: library code receives an injected Storage and never constructs FsStorage (P2.4)
rules.remedy: thread the Storage from the composition root (wiring / app entry)

rules.statement: library packages depend only on contracts, the kernel and vendored shims
rules.remedy: take the dependency through a contract, or move the code into wiring

rules.statement: CLI surface code throws EthosError, not raw Error (Phase 30.9)
rules.remedy: throw new EthosError({ code, cause, action })

rules.statement: test files may import any layer to build fixtures
rules.remedy: keep production code out of __tests__ and *.test.ts files

rules.statement: tool code reads configuration through ctx.*, not process.env
rules.remedy: use ctx.secrets / ctx.process; boot checks belong in isAvailable()

rules.statement: the sqlite shim is a thin platform wrapper with no Ethos semantics
rules.remedy: keep Ethos semantics out of the shim; put them in its caller

rules.statement: web-api rpc handlers validate input, call one service method and return its result
rules.remedy: move data access into a repository or service under apps/web-api/src
